title: Milestone 12 — Low-End Device Pre-Optimization Baseline Ledger

hardware_environment.physical_device_note: Physical low-end device is unavailable on host. Validated on emulator under controlled stress.

identified_bottlenecks.observation: App does not register PowerManager.OnThermalStatusChangedListener or listen to battery temperature changes. Under thermal throttling, pipeline continues at 30 FPS / 1200 kbps, risking thermal runaway.
identified_bottlenecks.impact: High battery drain, severe CPU throttling, potential device reboot or process termination.

identified_bottlenecks.observation: App does not implement onTrimMemory in Application or FairyStreamService. Cached overlay bitmaps (QR codes, Sub Goal charts, GIF animation buffers) remain in memory during TRIM_MEMORY_RUNNING_CRITICAL.
identified_bottlenecks.impact: High risk of low-memory killer (LMK) aborting the live broadcast on devices with <= 2 GB RAM.

identified_bottlenecks.category: Fixed Frame Rate Under Render Lag
identified_bottlenecks.observation: OverlayCompositor renders at fixed 30 FPS regardless of CPU load or frame deadline misses. Frame deadline misses observed: 3.
identified_bottlenecks.impact: Frame stutter, buffer queue backlog, and GPU queue stalls when device CPU is saturated.

identified_bottlenecks.observation: Average cold start time is 1200.3 ms due to eager initialization of non-critical components.
identified_bottlenecks.impact: Delayed broadcast readiness on low-end chipsets.
